Gridstack.js 13.2.0, vendored for Mason on 2026-11-18 (UIFIX item 6).

Why: templates/mason_v2.html loaded these two files from cdnjs. They now ship with Mason, so the dashboard
works with no internet and the public repository has no CDN dependency for its widget grid.

Source (byte-for-byte what the page loaded before):
  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gridstack.js/13.2.0/gridstack-all.min.js
  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gridstack.js/13.2.0/gridstack.min.css
Both were checked against the sha512 values cdnjs publishes for 13.2.0 (api.cdnjs.com/libraries/gridstack.js/13.2.0)
and against the npm package gridstack@13.2.0: gridstack.min.css is identical to dist/gridstack.min.css;
gridstack-all.min.js is dist/gridstack-all.js as cdnjs re-minified it: one object literal is written `{h:h}`
instead of `{h}` (same meaning) and the last line (the source-map comment) is left out. Nothing else differs.

Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2019-2025 Alain Dumesny (v0.4.0 and older (c) 2014-2018 Pavel Reznikov, Dylan Weiss).
  LICENSE                        the project's licence text (npm package gridstack@13.2.0, file LICENSE)
  gridstack-all.js.LICENSE.txt   the banner file the minified script's first line points to (npm dist/)
Project: https://gridstackjs.com/  ·  https://github.com/gridstack/gridstack.js

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, add a new versioned folder and change the two tags at the top of
templates/mason_v2.html.
